name: io.github.benseverndev-oss/goldenmatch
title: GoldenMatch
description: Find duplicate records in 30 seconds. Zero-config entity resolution, 97.2% F1 out of the box.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token for the hosted endpoint. It exposes tools that read and write files on the server, so anonymous access is refused (401). Ask the maintainer, or self-host with `goldenmatch mcp-serve`.
